---
title: "uv-python polars ecosystem rendering"
engine: uv-python
format: html
uv-python:
  with:
    - polars
execute:
  echo: false
---

This fixture uses transient `uv-python.with` dependencies. The captioned polars
table is referenced as @tbl-ecosystem-polars.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ecosystem-polars
#| tbl-cap: Polars dataframe rendered by uv-python
import math
import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "name": ["Ada", "Grace", "Katherine"],
        "note": ["literal | pipe", "line one\nline two", "backtick ` cell"],
        "score": [98.0, None, math.nan],
    }
)

df
```

Explicit `display(df)` should use the same dependency-free table formatter.

```{python}
from uv_python_runtime import display

display(df)
```

Polars Series values render as a two-column table with an ordinal index and the
series name.

```{python}
pl.Series("series_value", ["alpha", "series | pipe", None])
```
